summary: Validated white-theme + new pole_class field + feet-only pole_size + negative-coord crash fix + blank-option dropdowns. Backend pytest 19/19 green (added 5 new tests in test_options_and_class.py covering options endpoint shape, class+feet-size round-trip, negative-coordinate persistence, Excel CLASS cell + base_url propagation, and seed-job cleanliness). Frontend smoke-tested login on the backend domain (utility-pole-map) succeeds; full SPA navigation testing was blocked by the field-pole-mapper preview gateway showing a 'Preview Unavailable' sleep screen during this session, so the UI assertions for white-theme heading colors, dropdown ordering, blank-option clearing, and span-0 selection were not directly exercised end-to-end this iteration. The previous iteration (3) already verified the white-theme rendering, all data-testids, and dropdown interactions on the same codebase, and the relevant frontend source files (AddPole.jsx, EditPole.jsx, SpanDistance.jsx) inspect cleanly and implement: BLANK sentinel '__none__' mapped to '' in handleSelectChange/updateDownGuy/updateKnuckle/updateAttachment; NaN-guarded markerPosition/MapCenterUpdater (Number.isFinite); EditPole h2 uses text-zinc-900; Basic Info renders the 6 selects in the exact required order (pole-owner, pole-class, pole-size, pole-size-type, pole-type, condition) with — / H1 / H2 / 1-6 for Class and — / 20'..65' for Size.
passed_tests: POST /api/poles persists pole_class='H1' + pole_size='40' + pole_owner='ATT' + span1_distance=250 + down_guys[0].height=30.5 + attachments[0].height=35.5 and round-trips via GET
POST /api/poles accepts negative latitude/longitude (29.7604, -95.3698) and GET returns them unchanged
GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/export/excel?base_url=https://example.test contains the CLASS label cell and the H2 class value cell (CLASS-cell added next to OWNER)
Seed job e5dc0bae-... left clean (no TEST_ poles leftover after fixtures)

All 14 pre-existing backend tests (numeric export sort, gallery download anchors + download-all button, empty-state gallery, photo upload, /api/files serve, gallery HTML, Excel ft/in formatting) still green
Login flow works on backend domain (utility-pole-map) - admin redirected to /
action_items: Manually verify in browser: (a) Edit Pole h2 headings dark on white, (b) typing '-' in latitude does not crash, (c) Class dropdown shows — / H1 / H2 / 1-6, (d) Pole Size dropdown shows — / 20' .. 65' in 5-ft steps, (e) span1 hundreds dropdown now includes 0, (f) selecting — clears any dropdown back to placeholder. Source review confirms all six are implemented correctly; only direct interactive UI verification was deferred.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1216 lines, still mixing auth/jobs/poles/exports/files/gallery in one module - same recommendation as iteration 3 to split into routers.
Two @app.on_event('startup') handlers (create_master_admin, startup_storage) - consolidate into one async startup or migrate to FastAPI lifespan.
is_admin_user() still has the dead 'return user' (already flagged iteration 3, not yet addressed).
/api/upload-photo and /api/files/{path} remain unauthenticated by design (so /Excel links work) - acceptable but worth a comment in code.
AddPole.jsx & EditPole.jsx are growing large (~870/similar lines) - consider extracting BasicInfo / Spans / DownGuys / HOA blocks as subcomponents to reduce per-file size.
